name: @vibetasks/browser-extension
description: VibeTasks Browser Extension for error capture

scripts.build:chrome: echo 'No build needed - extension uses vanilla JS'
scripts.build:firefox: echo 'Copy manifest.firefox.json to manifest.json for Firefox'
scripts.zip:firefox: cp manifest.firefox.json manifest.json.bak && cp manifest.json manifest.chrome.json && cp manifest.firefox.json manifest.json && cd .. && zip -r browser-extension-firefox.zip browser-extension -x '*.git*' -x '*node_modules*' -x '*manifest.chrome.json*' -x '*manifest.firefox.json*' && cd browser-extension && mv manifest.chrome.json manifest.json && rm manifest.json.bak

author: VibeTasks
